exercise: Run the workflow and restart the application with external connectivity unavailable.
acceptance_criterion: The configured workflow completes after restart within the approved network boundary. Record any attempted egress and the observation point.

exercise: Attempt the same approval with an authorized reviewer, an unauthorized account and a revoked account.
acceptance_criterion: Only the authorized reviewer can approve. Record the observed revocation interval against the pilot threshold.

exercise: Propose a one-week move to a synthetic sample-readiness date and reject the proposal.
acceptance_criterion: The committed date remains unchanged. The rejection record includes the reviewer, time and evidence revision.

exercise: Submit a separate proposal and have the designated owner approve it.
acceptance_criterion: The committed change is traceable to the approval. Record any dependent firmware and qualification work separately.

exercise: Restore the supported backup in the approved test environment and review both decisions.
acceptance_criterion: The restored evidence and approval records reconcile with the pre-restore scope and retention criteria.

exercise: Import an approved test package and exercise the supported recovery procedure.
acceptance_criterion: Integrity and custody checks are recorded. The expected application version and workflow state are confirmed after recovery.
